Image2/3 are style/legibility references only: DO NOT copy their brown-haired identity or remove the shield.

Redraw the target deliberately for readability at about 60 screen pixels tall on a 128x96 stone floor tile. KEEP his identity: short compact sturdy silver-haired veteran with a short gray beard, warm visible face, crimson scarf/cape, silver shoulder plates, ivory tabard, brown leather boots, sword held diagonally down on viewer LEFT, wooden shield on viewer RIGHT. Keep full body, same frontal three-quarter eye-level direction as target, no top-down/isometric foreshortening. This is not a realistic illustration to be shrunk.

Actual transparent background, full sword/boots/shield included, modest transparent margin. NO floor/tile/base/background/UI/text/labels/extra characters.
